title: Make test_activate_task_writes_runtime_binding restore every runtime file it mutates
refined_problem: tests/test_opencode_integration.py::test_activate_task_writes_runtime_binding saves and restores active-task.json, legacy provider files and enriched-inventory.json, but never restores model-selections.json. Running the test against the real shared runtime leaves the live overlay's model-selections.json overwritten with the TEST-OPENCODE test payload, which then fails every subsequent provider-binding validation with 'provider model selections task mismatch' and blocked the deterministic check runner of an unrelated in-flight task. The fixture must be fully side-effect free.

original_request.text: El código de ese test tiene un descuido real que conviene arreglar: que restaure todos los archivos que toca. Puedo crear esa pequeña tarea de corrección después de terminar la actual, para que no le pase a nadie más. arregla esto

target_users: harness operators running the unittest suite from any checkout or worktree
AI agents executing deterministic task checks against the shared runtime
outcomes: Running the full unittest suite or the single test_opencode_integration module no longer mutates the real provider overlay state.
Provider binding validation remains consistent across test runs, eliminating the 'provider model selections task mismatch' failure mode.

in: a regression assertion proving the restoration covers model-selections.json
out: changes to any other test module
changes to harness policy or permission rules

mvp.goal: The test restores every runtime file it mutates, including model-selections.json, with a regression check that fails before the fix and passes after it.
includes: capture pre-state of model-selections.json next to the other saved files
restore it in the finally block alongside active-task.json and the legacy files
assert post-run byte-equality for the saved runtime files
excludes: reworking the whole integration fixture architecture

success_metrics: python -m unittest test_opencode_integration passes with the new regression assertion included
sha256 of every pre-existing file under .harness/overlays/<worktree-id>/opencode/ (except the append-only permission audit) is unchanged after running the module
assumptions: The provider overlay path is deterministic per worktree identity for the test process
Restoring model-selections.json bytes is sufficient; the enriched inventory and active-task.json restorations already exist
challenges: The test already restores several files with subtle quarantine semantics; the fix must preserve those existing invariants

work_items.title: Test fixture runtime-state hygiene
work_items.description: Keep integration tests that exercise the real provider activation boundary fully side-effect free for the shared runtime state.

tasks.title: Restore model-selections.json in test_activate_task_writes_runtime_binding
tasks.description: Fix tests/test_opencode_integration.py::test_activate_task_writes_runtime_binding so it captures the pre-state of model-selections.json and restores it in the finally block, with a regression assertion that the runtime overlay is byte-identical after the test runs.
acceptance_criteria: The test captures the pre-state of model-selections.json (bytes or sha256) before the subprocess activation runs.
The finally block restores model-selections.json to that pre-state, including the case where the file did not exist before.
A new regression assertion verifies the restoration (fails before the fix, passes after it).
After running the test module, no TEST-OPENCODE payload remains in any real overlay file and every pre-existing overlay file is byte-identical (permission audit append-only excepted).
